pipeline.title: Mirum on its way to 3rd rare liver indication for Livmarli
pipeline.summary: Livmarli significantly improved severe itching caused by rare liver diseases. With the phase 3 win in hand, Mirum is looking for a third indication from the FDA early next year.

pipeline.title: Roche sets sights on FDA approval decision of July 2027 with updated eye drug data
pipeline.summary: One year on from a mixed phase 3 readout, Roche has shared updated data from eye disease trials that could support FDA approval by July.

pipeline.title: Tortugas’ schizophrenia drug proves worth in phase 2 Hansoh trial in China
pipeline.summary: Tortugas Neuroscience’s schizophrenia drug from Hansoh Pharma has proven its worth in a phase 2b study, validating the fledgling biotech’s neurology strategy.

pipeline.title: BMS doubles up with pivotal wins in lung disease, solid tumor that offer hope for post-patent cliff growth
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has reported phase 3 wins in a lung disease and a solid tumor, taking two steps on its path toward post-patent cliff growth.

pipeline.title: How advanced AI can improve clinical trial decision-making
pipeline.summary: Life science foundation models can help teams anticipate patient outcomes and pressure-test trial designs.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Vir looks to Liu to lead late-stage push
pipeline.summary: As Vir pushes its lead hepatitis D combo through phase 3 development, the biotech has tapped an experienced medical expert to light the way. David Liu, M.D., Ph.D., is now Vir’s chief medical officer, after most recently serving in the same role at Nuvation Bio.

pipeline.title: Endeavor’s threat to IPF incumbents increases after phase 2 win for Hedgehog inhibitor
pipeline.summary: Endeavor BioMedicines solidified its potential threat to Big Pharma with a phase 2b readout suggesting its Hedgehog inhibitor could become the first drug to reduce lung fibrosis while increasing total lung capacity.

pipeline.title: Ono pays $80M for regional rights to trio of Biohaven IgG degraders, including phase 3 Grave’s asset
pipeline.summary: Japan’s Ono Pharmaceutical is paying $80 million upfront for the regional rights to a trio of Biohaven’s IgG degraders, led by a phase 3-stage Grave’s disease prospect.

pipeline.title: Zealand, Roche’s ‘intriguing’ weight loss for amylin drug soured by blood sugar data
